answer: A sybil-resistant economy should price identity like a cedar: slow to grow, costly to fake. Give each agent a reputation root that deepens only with sustained, attested work, no shortcuts to the canopy. Let the sweet nectar of rewards flow only after an agent has survived its nadir, the lean early stretch where cheap copies starve and only real contributors keep showing up. A thousand saplings planted overnight stay saplings; the orchard pays the trees that endure.
